# Figures Index

All visual assets in this repository, with one-line descriptions and the
source that generates them.

## Charts (generated by `scripts/generate_charts.py`)

| File | Shows | Story |
|---|---|---|
| [01-baseline-vs-advisory.png](figures/01-baseline-vs-advisory.png) | Finished-oil color, FFA, phosphorus before and after the AI advisory loop | Off-spec -> signed advisory -> on-spec |
| [02-attack-matrix.png](figures/02-attack-matrix.png) | Six verification cases: one accepted, five rejected at specific stages | Every attack fails at a named stage |
| [03-zone-conduit-map.png](figures/03-zone-conduit-map.png) | Five zones with allowed and blocked conduits | AI to PLC and enterprise to control are network-blocked |
| [04-compliance-coverage.png](figures/04-compliance-coverage.png) | ISO/IEC 42001 control matrix status counts | Honest picture of complete, draft, and open controls |

Regenerate with `python scripts/generate_charts.py`. CI runs this step
on every push.

## Diagrams (Mermaid source in `architecture/diagrams/`)

| File | Type | Shows |
|---|---|---|
| [integrated-architecture.mmd](../architecture/diagrams/integrated-architecture.mmd) | Flowchart | Five-layer architecture from field devices to enterprise governance |
| [advisory-sequence.mmd](../architecture/diagrams/advisory-sequence.mmd) | Sequence | Advisory flow: twin -> agents -> orchestrator -> compliance -> signer -> verifier -> operator -> MOC |
| [verifier-stages.mmd](../architecture/diagrams/verifier-stages.mmd) | State machine | Eight-stage fail-closed verification with reject paths |

Render any `.mmd` file at https://mermaid.live, or with `mmdc`.

## How to use these images

- README: the four charts are embedded inline
- LinkedIn: chart 02 (attack matrix) and chart 03 (zone map) are the
  two strongest visuals for follow-up posts
- Talks and papers: all four charts are 140 DPI PNGs
